subject: Quick customer spotlight: short G2 rating + one-line quote from Avalon Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@avalonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick customer spotlight: short G2 rating + one-line quote from Avalon Health

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for running the pilot with Redwood Inference — we really appreciate the close partnership and the feedback your team shared on latency and cost. Would you be open to a very short public rating on G2 and one-line quote we could use in a customer spotlight?

Details:
- It takes ~3 minutes to leave a star rating + 1–2 sentence comment on G2.
- As a thank-you we can send a $100 Visa e‑gift or a $100 donation to a charity you pick.
- You can either: (A) post directly using this link: https://www.g2.com/r/redwood-inference/reviews/new?company=avalon-health or (B) reply with a one-line sentence and permission to attribute it to Avalon Health and we’ll add it to our short spotlight.

I attached a 1‑page guide ("g2-review-steps.pdf") with screenshots to make it easy. If you prefer, Marissa can jump on a 10‑minute call to capture a quote live.

Would Friday (9/11) morning work for a quick sync or is reply-by-email easier?

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0198

I’ll aim to submit the rating by end of day Monday (9/14). If you need a one-line quote sooner: feel free to draft one and send it over for review.

Best,
